title: Run Wireshark without root permissions
body: Configure capture permissions to run Wireshark as a normal user on Linux.

title: Increase WSL 2 memory limit
body: Change the memory allocated to WSL 2 using the .wslconfig file.

title: Reduce application memory usage
body: Profile a process to reduce its memory consumption.

title: Disable Android application notifications
body: Turn off notifications for a single application in Android settings.

title: Change Android notification sound
body: Choose a new sound for incoming application notifications.

title: Extend Android battery life
body: Reduce background activity and screen brightness.
